title: speq shared definitions v1
description: Definitions shared by more than one .speq artifact schema. Steps, assertions and generator blocks are the same constructs in a test spec, a suite init hook and a module action, so they are defined once here and referenced. This file describes no artifact of its own.

module.description: Module path relative to the modules directory.

alias.description: Name this module is referenced by in 'action'. Defaults to the module's own name.

type.description: 'api' issues an HTTP request; 'use' invokes a reusable step file or a module action.

id.description: Step identifier, referenced by a module's 'returns' expressions.

name.description: Human-readable step name, reported in run results.

method.description: HTTP method. Required for 'api' steps and ignored otherwise.

url.description: Request URL, absolute or relative to the environment's baseUrl. Required for 'api' steps and ignored otherwise.

headers.description: Request headers. Values must be strings — quote numeric values in YAML.

body.description: Request body. May contain generator blocks. Mutually exclusive with 'bodyFromFixture'.

bodyFromFixture.description: Build the request body from a fixture. Mutually exclusive with 'body'.

ref.description: For 'use' steps: path to a reusable step file. Either 'ref' or 'action' is required.

action.description: For 'use' steps: module action, as '<module-or-alias>.<action>'. Either 'ref' or 'action' is required.

properties.description: Parameters passed into a module action for this call.

as.description: Binds the step result under this name, so later steps can reference {{<name>.…}}. Meaningful for 'use' steps calling a module action with 'returns'.

assert.description: Assertions evaluated against the step's response.

condition.description: Gate the step on a condition, optionally polling until it holds.

timeoutMs.description: Narrowest level of the request timeout: overrides the manifest and environment 'http.timeoutMs' for this step only. Milliseconds.

continueOnError.description: Keep the group running past this step's failure. The step is still recorded as failed and the test still fails; only the steps after it are still attempted. Without it, the first step that does not pass ends its group and the rest are reported 'skipped'.

status.description: ATDD lifecycle status. When set to 'pending', the step is skipped and later steps depending on it cascade to pending. 'pending' is the only accepted value.

then.$comment: The parser rejects a step carrying both 'body' and 'bodyFromFixture'.

as.$comment: The parser enforces this identifier rule on 'use' steps only.

httpTransport.description: Transport policy for outbound requests, parsed as HttpConfig in speq-cli/src/manifest/mod.rs. Declared in the manifest and narrowed per environment; the two are merged field by field, so an environment block overrides only the fields it names. A step's 'timeoutMs' narrows the request budget once more.

timeoutMs.description: Total budget for one request, in milliseconds. A request that outlives it fails with 'timeout: request exceeded <n>ms budget'. reqwest has no default of its own, so without this the runtime applies 30000.

connectTimeoutMs.description: Budget for establishing the connection, a subset of timeoutMs. Must not exceed timeoutMs.

oneOf.description: false never follows a redirect; true follows up to 10 hops.
Maximum number of hops to follow. 0 is equivalent to false.

followRedirects.description: Redirect policy. Accepts a bool or an explicit hop limit.

proxy.description: Proxy URL applied to every request, for example 'http://proxy.internal:8080'.

caFile.description: PEM bundle of additional roots to trust, relative to the project root. For a private or self-signed certificate authority.

clientCert.description: PEM client certificate for mutual TLS, relative to the project root. Requires 'clientKey'.

clientKey.description: PEM private key for 'clientCert', relative to the project root. Requires 'clientCert'.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Disables certificate verification. Accepted so a self-signed staging API is testable, not because it is safe -- never set it against an environment that holds real data.

httpMethod.description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS. The parser upper-cases before comparing, so any casing is accepted; uppercase is canonical. TRACE is not supported.

ref.description: Fixture name, resolved against the fixtures directory.

overrides.description: Fields merged over the fixture's built body. Must be an object.

path.description: JSONPath into the response, for the assertion kinds that address a field.

value.description: Accepted spelling of 'expected', the way 'markers' is accepted for 'tags'. Supplying both in one assertion is a parse error in speq-cli, so this schema rejects it too. Prefer 'expected'.

ref.description: For 'schema' assertions: schema file, resolved against the schemas directory.

inline.description: For 'schema' assertions: the schema itself, written in place.

not.$comment: 'value' is an alias of 'expected' in speq-cli, so writing both raises a duplicate-field parse error rather than one winning.

equals.description: The value the path must equal for the condition to hold. Any JSON value, including null.

wait.description: Poll until the condition holds. The parser additionally requires timeoutMs >= intervalMs, which JSON Schema cannot express.

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many milliseconds. Must be >= intervalMs.

valueOrGen.$comment: Any JSON value. An object whose only key is 'gen' is a generator block and is validated as one; otherwise objects and arrays are walked, mirroring validate_gen_in_value in speq-cli/src/generator/mod.rs.

generator.description: Generated value. Resolved in test variables, request bodies and fixture builds.
